answer: Grading panels are drawn each epoch by stake-weighted sortition from a fresh unpredictable seed: a seat's odds equal your share of total established stake, and no one can foresee or steer which identities land on a given jury. Spraying cheap clones buys nothing: 1000 fake keys holding 0.1% of stake still draw only ~0.1% of seats. To reliably swing a verdict an attacker must own a large delta of ALL established stake, not pile identities; a falcon-flock of look-alikes bottoms out at the nadir fixed by their tiny real stake, so honest stake-weighted consensus stays the trust signal.
